# email-dns-audit

> Audit a domain's email DNS records over an injected resolver: SPF syntax and the 10-lookup limit per RFC 7208, DMARC policy per RFC 7489 and DKIM selector keys Go module `github.com/Trysac/u262-email-dns-audit`, package `emaildnsaudit`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.
